description:
Look up a US address (or bare 5-digit ZIP): ZIP-level home-price appreciation
    forecast (FHFA data back to 1975), estimated market rent, and neighborhood signals
    (schools, walkability, water quality, grocery/dining/outdoors proximity).

    For a full street address this also returns sub-ZIP `nbhd*` fields describing the
    specific census tract - how its prices, incomes and build era compare to the rest of
    the ZIP. That is POSITION, not a neighborhood forecast; see _units.

    property_type: sfr | condo | townhome | multi

address.description: Full US street address, or a bare 5-digit ZIP. Pass it whenever it is known: it grounds property tax, insurance and the appreciation forecast in that ZIP's real figures instead of national defaults.
address.title: Address

bedrooms.description: Bedroom count, used to select the matching market-rent estimate for the ZIP. Defaults to 2.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

property_type.description: One of: sfr (single-family), condo, townhome, multi.
property_type.title: Property Type

name: analyze_address
